item.title: Agent loops that actually stop
item.description: Most “autonomous” demos never terminate. Here’s how I structure loops with clear exit conditions, tool budgets, and human handoff points.

item.title: MCP without the hype
item.description: Model Context Protocol is just structured tool access. What changes when you treat servers like microservices instead of magic plugins.

item.title: When not to build an agent
item.description: Sometimes the right architecture is a form, a queue, and a function. A short checklist before you add a planner.

item.title: Evals that catch regressions
item.description: Golden sets, spot checks, and the difference between demo evals and the ones you run before deploy.
